scientific_question: Does the single sign-level assurance rescue observed in the initial frozen v14 block recur when every model setting is held fixed and only a deliberately non-overlapping stochastic seed block is changed?
decision_rule: If sign rescue recurs (>0), call sign-level synthetic buffering replicated across two stochastic blocks but still sparse unless frequency is materially larger.
If sign rescue does not recur (=0) while magnitude rescues remain common, revise the claim to robust magnitude attenuation with non-robust sign-level rescue.
If magnitude rescues also disappear, revise the assurance capability claim more strongly downward.
forbidden: do not change assurance ranges after seeing this block
do not search seed blocks until a sign rescue appears
do not pool blocks and call the aggregate a replication
do not use Hawaiʻi or other empirical outcomes to choose the seed or threshold
claim_boundary: This is a stochastic robustness check of synthetic capability only. It does not change empirical mechanism admission.
